question: Does a four-point Dusk mediator payout increase make the already frozen v9 repertoire viable on both vows without global movement or reliability regression?

repertoire.discovery: v9 frozen selection, seeds 136000-136031, Duskblade vows 0 and 5
repertoire.validation: v9 frozen selection, seeds 137000-137063, Duskblade vows 0 and 5

competingOptions.statement: The frozen policies retain both routes and meet C2 under both vows with no guardrail movement.
The frozen repertoire remains underpowered or the conditional payout causes movement, collapse, ceiling or reliability failure.

estimands.functionalSeparation: Named diagonal interaction lower 95% bound at least 0.25 SD; every off-diagonal upper bound below 0.25.
estimands.panelActivation: Named consumer response in AB minus B, standardised by pooled consumer response; lower 95% bound at least 0.25 SD.
estimands.globalMovement: Candidate-minus-live RandomBuild arm-2 point movement is at most 0.10 per grid; a bound-overlapping interval extends.
estimands.heldoutViability: For each Dusk route and vow, at least two frozen policies activate the mediator and exceed same-split RandomBuild arm 2 by at least 0.35.
estimands.retention: Both route best-policy rates per vow remain within 0.10 and credited policy sets differ.
estimands.reliability: Paired candidate-minus-live added stalls over the frozen selection; any added stall or simulator error fails.
estimands.vow5: Every frozen-policy held-out vow-5 win rate is at most 0.90.

successRule.functionalSeparation: All four diagonals and twelve off-diagonals pass discovery and held-out evidence.
successRule.packageActivation: All four packages meet activation, witness, aspect-separation, reliability and duration gates in both splits.
successRule.globalMovement: Every held-out RandomBuild movement is within 0.10.
successRule.heldoutViability: Both Dusk routes retain at least two C2-viable policies under vows 0 and 5 in discovery and validation.
successRule.retention: Both route endpoints remain within 0.10 and use distinct credited policy sets.
successRule.reliability: No candidate-added stall and zero candidate/live simulator errors.
successRule.vow5: All frozen-policy held-out vow-5 win rates are at most 0.90.

cheapestDiscriminatingExperiment: Re-run exact-input package and control gates, then apply the immutable v9 selection to 32 fresh paired discovery seeds and 64 independent paired validation seeds for both Dusk vows.
inconclusiveRule: Control intervals may extend to 128. Frozen-repertoire rectangles are final at their stated sizes; no reselection or content change is allowed inside v10.
stopRule: Reject on separation, activation, movement, fewer than two viable policies per route/vow, endpoint collapse, a candidate-added stall, simulator error or Vow-5 ceiling breach. Detector mutations remain forbidden until all pass.
